_comment: Copy this file to ticket-master.config.json and fill in your own values.
_comment_placeholders: Optional: if this config lives in a folder synced across several machines (e.g. a cloud-synced parent directory), 'tickets_dir' and any project_roots[].path may use the placeholders <HOME> (current user's home directory) and <USER> (OS user name) instead of a literal, host-specific path -- same convention as config/ticket-writer.config.example.json. The agent following the TICKET-MASTER prompt resolves these to the current host's actual values before any file access; a literal path is still fine for a single-machine setup.
_comment_prompts_dir: Repository-local directory containing TICKET-MASTER.<lang>.md. All three starters resolve this field through bin/ticket_master.py; paths escaping the repository root are rejected.
_comment_language: Prompt language. Override at runtime with TM_LANG; invalid or missing language files fall back to 'en' with a warning.

project_roots._comment: Add your own project directories here.
project_roots.name: my-software

claude._comment: Anthropic Claude CLI (https://github.com/anthropic-ai/claude-code). Set TM_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=1 to pass --dangerously-skip-permissions.

codex._comment: OpenAI Codex CLI (https://github.com/openai/codex). Adjust command path as needed.

agy._comment: Gemini CLI or compatible wrapper. Adjust command path as needed.

advisor._comment: Optional: advisor model for high-stakes tickets (score >= 35). Not programmatically configurable in all harnesses — may require manual activation.

score_thresholds._comment: FALLBACK ONLY (Phase 3, T-20260704-02): used when 'router_command' below is unset or unreachable. Map score ranges to provider tiers. Adjust to match your available models.

_comment_router_command: Phase 3 (T-20260704-02): optional external multi-model/task router (CLI or script). If set, the prompt consults it FIRST for tier/model recommendation; 'score_thresholds' above only applies as a fallback when this is null or the router is unreachable.
_comment_task_db_command: Phase 3 (T-20260704-02): optional 'later' sink for tickets whose urgency (see config/urgency.json) is 'woche' or 'backlog' -- a background task-tracking CLI/API entry point. If null, such tickets fall back to DECISION LADDER item 1 (the project's own task management).

logging._comment: Deprecated: intake_log (shared file) removed in 1.5.0 - audit trail lives per ticket (STATUS/LOG/SOLUTION fields).
